name: hero reveal with radiating rays and a completion title
looks: The combined figure stands held in frame as fine rays radiate out from behind it, brightening, with a final bold title stamping "complete" over the glow.
build: wordmark-assemble's settle stage over a radial ray burst (thin lines rotating slowly from the centre, ramping opacity); the title slams in on back.out with a flash frame just before it lands.

prompt: Hold the finished result in frame as fine rays radiate out from behind it and brighten, then slam a short completion title over the glow as the payoff beat. Use it as the victory moment after a build or transformation sequence.
